game_title: Name Tag Match – Tavern Quarter Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the town guard must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing apples before they reach siege rats.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing apples before they reach siege rats. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about tag_matches to power up the town guard and open the market bell.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Tavern Quarter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Tavern Quarter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
